BiblicalUsage: Shallun repaired the fountain gate in Nehemiah's Jerusalem, as ruler of part of Mizpah. He built it and covered it, and set up the doors and the locks and the bars, and the wall of the pool of Siloah beside it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God remembers the man who rebuilt a gate, because the wall of His city was raised by rulers who worked with their hands.
